title: event-items-overview.html
content: Please read before adding custom Event Items. To use a custom Event Item, users need to create a new, unique custom picklist value in the field on the Event Item. A custom Event Item behaves like an Event Item with = "Main event ticket". This will resolve the “ticket type is not supported for registration” error. The Event Item = "Other" should only be used for Products. Event Item Types There are three primary types of s that can be added to an : Tickets Includes free and paid Main event tickets and Guest tickets. = “Main event item” or = “Guest” An with = "Main event ticket" must be included to publish an with a "Guest" . Donations Gives s an easy way to make a donation. = “Donation” An with = "Main event ticket" must be included to publish an with a "Donation" . Products Used to offer a product to s. = “Other” An with = "Main event ticket" must be included to publish an with a "Product" . Sort Event Items
